what: Plan claims phase-2 launches are serialized within one dispatcher call; implementation backgrounds every phase-2 slot then waits once in collect_phase
scenario_or_breakage: Peer slots in the same fallback_group can both pass the empty ledger and launch duplicate Codex before any row is written; write+rename after success does not serialize concurrent launch_slot calls
suggested_fix: Revise dispatch-with-waterfall.sh phase-2 loop to process fallback_group members sequentially (launch/wait/ledger per group) or add a pre-launch group lock; remove or correct the serialized phase-2 invariant in dispatch-with-waterfall.md and plan edge cases

what: Proposed dedup only consults/writes the ledger around phase-2 Codex fallback; no step records phase-1 OK rows for grouped slots
scenario_or_breakage: Motivating #2898 case: decomp-codex-* settles phase-1 Codex OK while decomp-cursor-* fails --require-result-pattern and needs phase-2 Codex; ledger empty so redundant Codex still runs
suggested_fix: After each collect_phase (at least phase-1), append ledger rows for slots with fallback_group when STATUS is OK/cap_hit (tool + resolved output path); dedup scan must match group+tool across phases not only phase-2 launches
